help.goal: Capture all twelve of your opponent's pieces, or leave them with no legal move.
steps: Wait until the top line says your move.
Tap one of your pieces — its legal squares light up green.
Tap a lit square to move or jump there.
If a jump is on offer you must take it: only jumps light up.
After a jump the same piece stays picked when it can jump again — tap the next square.
Tap Resign 🏳️ to hand the game over.
notes: Plain pieces only move forward, diagonally, one dark square at a time.
Reach the far row and you are crowned 👑: kings move and jump both ways. Crowning ends the turn, even mid-jump.
Play alone and a bot takes the seat: Easy plays anything legal, Normal counts the trades, Sharp searches five moves deep.
Forty moves each with no capture is a draw.
